span.p: Ready

span.p: Last call

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: Break / Lunch

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
the customer hangs up
media gone. No channel, no resource held.

div.style: color: rgb(74, 47, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
AFTER_CALL_WORK starts HERE
the clock runs from DISCONNECT, not from
any form action. No new call is offered.

div.style: color: rgb(11, 37, 69) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

p.b:
two independent things to do,
in whatever order suits the agent

div.style: color: rgb(11, 37, 69) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
A. our record
edit the AI-drafted summary,
pick a disposition, add follow-ups

div.style: color: rgb(51, 51, 51) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
B. everything else
another internal tool, a paper form,
a colleague to ask, a note to write

div.style: color: rgb(11, 37, 69) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: SAVE - only ever pressed by a human

div.style: color: rgb(8, 54, 29) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
call record closed.
Our system's work is finished -
which is NOT the same as the agent being free.

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
the agent declares what they do next
THIS is what ends ACW

div.style: color: rgb(8, 54, 29) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: ACW ends · offerable

div.style: color: rgb(8, 54, 29) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: ACW ends · offerable, then stops

div.style: color: rgb(74, 47, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: ACW ends · not offerable

div.style: color: rgb(74, 47, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: ACW ends · not offerable

div.style: color: rgb(92, 26, 19) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
there is NO auto-save. An earlier draft of this
decision had a timer save the record 'so a call cannot
hang open'. That was wrong three times over:
it contradicted 'pre-filled, never auto-saved'; nothing
is actually held open once the customer hangs up; and
an unsaved wrap-up is HONEST data - it records that
this call was never wrapped up.

div.style: color: rgb(74, 56, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
why ANY state ends ACW, not just Ready.
An agent who saves the record and goes to lunch has
finished their after-call work - they are simply not
available. Ending ACW only on Ready would show them
in after-call work for an hour.

div.style: color: rgb(74, 56, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
the two axes do all the work here.
system_state: AFTER_CALL_WORK -> AVAILABLE (the platform
has no work for you). agent_intent: whatever they chose.
Offerable is still AVAILABLE AND intent in (ready, last_call).
Lunch ends ACW and stays un-offerable, with no new state.

div.style: color: rgb(74, 56, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
any timer is a VISIBILITY device only.
After a threshold it raises a long-ACW indicator for
the agent and their supervisor. It writes nothing
and changes no state. It must never auto-ready.

div.style: color: rgb(8, 54, 29) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
still one click in the common case:
Save & Ready together. They separate only
when the agent needs them to.
